g.aria-label: Serializes path → tensor bytes; requires matching Python code to rebuild
8-byte length + JSON header + aligned raw bytes; zero RCE, zero-copy mmap
Model state + Optimizer m,v + PRNG states + step t + config (12 B/param)
Write to path + ".tmp" then os.replace() so crashes never corrupt ckpt
Always assert missing_keys and unexpected_keys equal only replaced layers
